description:
We are a group of six enthusiastic students passionate about technology, space exploration, science, and innovation. We believe that great ideas come from teamwork, curiosity, and the courage to explore the unknown.

As aspiring developers and problem-solvers, we are excited to take on real-world challenges using NASA' open data

We value teamwork, fresh perspectives, creativity, and a willingness to learn.

Our goal is simple: Think beyond boundaries, build together, and reach for the stars!
